guide.kubanhorizons.page1:
KUBAN HORIZONS

Welcome to the fertile lands between the black-earth steppe and the warm sea. This guide will help you begin.
guide.kubanhorizons.page2:
FERTILE SOIL

Crops exhaust farmland. Use the soil probe to inspect fertility. Compost exhausted soil and rotate crops between harvests.
guide.kubanhorizons.page3:
FIELD CROPS

Grow sunflower and corn on farmland. Rice needs a flooded field. Tomatoes can be harvested repeatedly after ripening.
guide.kubanhorizons.page4:
TEA AND GRAPES

Tea grows on soil and gives new leaves after each harvest. Build a trellis, then graft a grape cutting onto it.
guide.kubanhorizons.page5:
IRRIGATION

Place a water intake beside water, then lead irrigation channels to your fields. Wet channels hydrate nearby farmland.
guide.kubanhorizons.page6:
THE ORCHARD

Plant peach, apricot, plum, and walnut saplings. Ripe fruit appears in the crown and can be picked without cutting the tree.
guide.kubanhorizons.page7:
CRAFT AND PROCESS

The oil press turns sunflower seeds into oil. Dry tea and fruit under open skies. Turn the hand mill to grind grain.
guide.kubanhorizons.page8:
KUBAN KITCHEN

Bake bread, brew tea, and cook local dishes from your harvest. Follow advancements to discover every branch of the homestead.
guide.kubanhorizons.title: Guide to Kuban
